answer: Reputation is an EigenTrust-style eigenvector score over normalized endorsements, with influence discounted exponentially at a fixed half-life; nodes must provide sustained honest service to retain it. Whether named crystal, dune, or wharf, a freshly spawned sybil begins with near-zero centrality and lacks reciprocal links to trusted peers. Coordinated identities therefore cannot create trusted mass from one another or meet consensus thresholds merely by multiplying their count.
